NSCameraUsageDescription: K-Bap uses the camera to scan menus, take photos for your reviews, and set your profile picture.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: K-Bap accesses your photos so you can scan a saved menu, add photos to reviews and posts, set a profile picture, or attach them to an inquiry.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your K-Bap story card to your photo library.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: K-Bap uses your location to find nearby restaurants, so you can tag a place in a review and record where you ate.
